sloka: तत: सा सम्प्रतिश्राव्य तव माता यशस्विनी ।अयाचत नरश्रेष्ठं द्वौ वरौ वरवर्णिनी ॥ २.१०७.५॥
transliteration: tata: sā sampratiśrāvya tava mātā yaśasvinī ।ayācata naraśreṣṭhaṁ dvau varau varavarṇinī ॥ 2.107.5॥

translations.english: Thereafter, O tiger among men, your illustrious mother of fair complexion, under oath demanded of that best of men, king Dasaratha, the two boons, namely kingdom for you and banishment for me. Bound by such agreement (oath), the king granted her the boons.
